coverage_rule: PNCP is complementary only. Agency CNPJs are discovered from PNCP municipal procurements for Salvador and the configured municipality CNPJ is always added when valid. Municipal-agency coverage is complete only when upstream procurement discovery completes and every supplied CNPJ/date contract query reaches a normal source end. Partial PNCP coverage never removes or invalidates the independently collected Salvador contract grid.
